title: E-Commerce Platform
description: A full-featured e-commerce platform built with Next.js, featuring real-time inventory management, payment processing with Stripe, and an admin dashboard. Handles 10k+ daily transactions with sub-100ms response times.
solution: Built a server-rendered Next.js frontend with ISR for product pages, Redis for cart state, and a PostgreSQL database with read replicas for query performance.
architecture: Next.js 15 App Router with server components for product listing, client components for cart interactions. Stripe Checkout for PCI-compliant payments. Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL. Redis for session and cart caching. Deployed on Vercel with edge functions for API routes.
